headline: A 1998 executive order changed an earlier order that assigns emergency preparedness duties to federal agencies.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12656, a 1988 order that tells federal departments and agencies what each must do to prepare for national security emergencies. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Their assigned emergency preparedness duties under Executive Order 12656 may have been changed or added to.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 9, 1998; the effective date is not stated in the information provided.
